newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks weaken early in rudderless trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks weaken early in rudderless trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks weakened early on Thursday morning in rudderless trade, amid a lack of factors to provide firm direction, brokers said.

They added that there was support for the Nikkei average around 19,500, but pressure from profit taking was strong near 20,000 and investors were discouraged by the inability of the benchmark to make substantial progress on the upside.
As of 0022 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was down 20.00 points or 0.10 percent at 19,677.17. September Nikkei futures fell 50 points to 19,650.
